title: Switzerland Family Holiday
headline: Two lake towns, trains between them, one mountain day.
description: A six-night family alpine holiday: Lucerne and Interlaken, with rail instead of long coach days.
image_alt: The Matterhorn above an alpine village in Switzerland
price_label: Quoted for your family and rail
price_guidance: Family pricing depends on room type, child rail discounts and which mountain you add. Peak tickets and international flights sit outside the base figure unless you ask us to include them.
overview: A family Switzerland that does not try to cover the whole country. Two stays, trains children can sit through, and one mountain day. The rest can be lakes and playgrounds.
highlights: One mountain excursion paced for families.
why: Two hotels, not a nightly pack.
Child rail fares applied where the pass allows.
Daily load can be cut if the mountain day is enough.
inclusions: Arrival transfer or rail as quoted
Accommodation on twin or family-room sharing as quoted
One mountain excursion as specified in your quote
exclusions: Second peaks and paid activities unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees
